procedural_matters: Hearing No. 7 was heard together with hearing No. 6 in accordance with RRS 63.2(b) since both hearings arose from the same incident.
ITA 211 -Robe da Mat- was represented by Tomislav Basic (tactician).
ITA 18266 -Nextgen- was represented by Claudio Arborea (tactician).
ITA 15852 -Magic Bus- was represented by Marco Cali (helmsman).
Pietro Cali (owner of Magic Bus) attended the hearing as an observer.
Jacob Marceneak (navigator of ITA 211) presented evidence from the tracking as a witness.
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident were 5-6 knots of wind and bumpy cross waves.
ITA 211 -Robe da Mat- (11m LoA), ITA 18266 -Nextgen- (10 m LoA) and ITA 15852 -Magic Bus- (12m LoA) were sailing on the run towards mark 4p of the leeward gate, to be rounded to port.

All three boats were sailing at a VMG angle, which was approximately 130 degrees from the true wind. ITA 211 -Robe da Mat- and ITA 18266 -Nextgen- with the gennaker, and ITA 15852 -Magic Bus- with the spinnaker.
ITA 15852 -Magic Bus- entered the zone sailing on starboard tack, clear ahead of ITA 18266 -Nextgen- who was sailing at 4 knots.
ITA 18266 -Nextgen- entered the zone sailing on starboard tack, clear ahead of ITA 211 -Robe da Mat-, who was also on starboard tack and sailing at a speed of 5.7 knots.

When ITA 15852 -Magic Bus- was two boat lengths from the mark, she dropped the spinnaker while gybing to port tack on a VMG angle and slowed down to a speed of 2 knots and immediately after ITA 18266 -Nextgen- gybed to port tack as well and subsequently dropped the gennaker. ITA 18266 -Nextgen- sailing faster, established an outside overlap to leeward of ITA 15852 -Magic Bus-, at a lateral distance of 1.5 metres.
At that moment an inside overlap was established between ITA 211 -Robe da Mat-, still on starboard tack, ITA 15852 -Magic Bus-, and ITA 18266 -Nextgen-.

At the mark, ITA 211 -Robe da Mat- gybed to port tack and at that moment the lateral distance between her and ITA 15852 -Magic Bus- was one metre and between ITA 15852 -Magic Bus-, and ITA 18266 -Nextgen- the distance was one metre as well.
Both ITA 15852 -Magic Bus- and ITA 18266 -Nextgen- bore away.
There was no contact between the boats.
ITA 211 -Robe de Mat- rounded the mark in front of ITA 15852 -Magic Bus- and ITA 18266 -Nextgen-.
conclusions: ITA 211 -Robe da Mat- not overlapped with ITA 15852 -Magic Bus- and ITA 18266 -Nextgen- and not in the zone at the time ITA 15852 -Magic Bus- and ITA 18266 -Nextgen- reached the zone, failed to give ITA 15852 -Magic Bus- and ITA 18266 -Nextgen- mark-room, and broke RRS 18.2(a)(2).
decision: ITA 211 -Robe da Mat- is DSQ in race #2.
